name: one-arm-chin-up
instructions:
1. Using a supinated grip, grasp the bar with one hand and allow your other arm to hang freely (or wrap around your wrist if needed).
2. Take a deep breath, squeeze your glutes and brace your abs. Depress the shoulder blade and drive the elbow straight down towards the floor while activating the lat.
3. Pull your chin towards the bar until the lat is fully contracted, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position and repeat for the assigned number of repetitions.
